title: Welcome to New Music Hub
summary: What New Music Hub is, what we publish, and how to enjoy music safely and legally.
content: New Music Hub is a place to discover, stream, and download music shared by our team.
We focus on supporting creators and promoting music that is shared with the right permissions.
If you are an artist and want to feature your music, use our Contact page to reach us.

title: How to Download Music Safely
summary: Simple tips for safe downloads and respecting artist rights.
content: Only download music you have permission to use. Respect copyright and the work of artists.
Keep your device safe: download from trusted sources and scan files if your device supports it.
If you find any content you believe should not be on this site, contact us and we will review it.

title: Supporting Artists: Why It Matters
summary: Streaming is great — here are practical ways to support the artists you love.
content: Follow artists on social platforms and share their music.
Attend live shows when possible and buy official merchandise.
If an artist offers direct downloads or subscriptions, that is one of the best ways to support them.
